title: Contestants
subtitle: Register contestants and keep their records current; search by name or phone number
account_hint: The account must already exist — this screen links a contestant to their account, it does not create accounts.
account_id_hint: Your permissions do not include browsing accounts; enter the account id (UUID) directly.
country_immutable_hint: Country cannot be changed after registration.
national_id_hint: Optional. Sensitive data — never shown in the contestants list.
national_id_edit_hint: Leave blank to keep the stored value; anything typed here replaces it.
delete_message: The record for {{name}} will be deleted. Deletion is reversible through restore, and nothing about the contestant is lost.
create_error: The contestant could not be registered.
update_error: The contestant could not be updated.
delete_error: The contestant could not be deleted.
restore_error: The contestant could not be restored.
account_missing: The account this contestant links to no longer exists.
country_missing: The country this contestant links to no longer exists.
name_divergence: The account name differs from the contestant's name.
memberships_empty: This contestant has never belonged to a circle.
memberships_withheld: Your permissions do not include viewing circle history.
